title: 第15章 我是魔你跟我讲道理第16章 哇我好怕哦
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
“掌使大人输了？”
被屠杀的巡夜司众人，苦苦坚持。
他们心中坚信，掌使大人很快就能打败夜洐，消灭邪魔。
没想到短短三四分钟，输了，输了很彻底。
夜洐怎么变得如此可怕，如此强，他怎么做到的。
怎么办？
彻底怕了。
开始慌不择路的逃命，忠诚？保命更重要。
“夜洐，饶了我，你还记得吗，我请你去勾栏听过曲啊。”
“我们一起喝过酒，我们是好友。”
有人求饶，攀关系。
“夜洐，够了，别再一错再错了，你怎么变得如此残忍无情。”
独树一帜的批评声，打破杀戮。
大开杀戒的白骨夫人四人，下意识停手，全力防备。
这是来了某个大人物了？
不然怎敢如此训斥大人。
举目看去，一个少女，身穿月华裙的世家女子沈微，面色无惧看着夜洐，步伐坚定走向夜洐：“夜洐，我知道你有怨气，你不甘，但是我们何错之友，你为何要屠杀我们。”
“两年前，又不是我们害的你入狱，你凭什么伤害我们，今日我们可是来欢迎你回来，你就如此心狠手辣，你怎么变得如此陌生。”
“你不是我认识的夜洐，我认识我欣赏，我佩服的夜洐，绝不会如此残忍，不会如此蛮不讲理。”
声声掷地，铿锵有力。

“这是跟大人有恩情的女子。”
“大人以前的青梅竹马？”
白骨夫人等人心中不由升起八卦之火，不敢阻止走向夜洐的沈微。
“你是？”
夜洐看着有些熟悉的沈微，名字忘了。
不重要。
对沈微招了招手，看着眼前的少女，眼中无惧，还带着世家贵女特有的傲慢。
“你在跟我讲道理？”
“难道不能讲理吗？世间万物运转离不开道.......”
夜洐慢慢拔出腰间还染血的木棍：“别怕，我不打女人，最怜香惜玉，你继续说。”
拔刀的速度不停。
content_en:
"Lord Commander, did you lose?"
The people of the Night Watch Division who were massacred struggled to hold on.
They firmly believed in their hearts that Master Zhang would be able to defeat Ye Zhi and eliminate the evil spirits soon.
Unexpectedly, in just three or four minutes, I lost, and I lost completely.
How did Ye Zhi become so terrifying and powerful? How did he do it?
what to do?
Totally scared.
Begin to flee for your life in a panic, loyalty? Saving one's life is more important.
"Ye Hu, please forgive me, do you still remember? I asked you to go listen to the music in Goulan."
"We drank together and we're good friends."
Some people beg for mercy and seek relationships.
"Ye Hu, that's enough. Don't make the same mistake again and again. Why have you become so cruel and heartless?"
Unique critical voice breaks the killing.
The four White Bone Madams who were going on a killing spree subconsciously stopped and took full precautions.
Is this a big shot coming?
Otherwise, how dare you reprimand the Lord like this.
Looking up, a young girl from an aristocratic family wearing a moonlight skirt looked at Ye Wei with a fearless expression. She walked towards Ye Wei with firm steps: "Ye Wei, I know you have grievances and you are not willing to accept it, but why are you our wrong friends, why do you want to massacre us."
"Two years ago, we were not the ones who put you in jail. Why did you hurt us? Today we are here to welcome you back. You are so cruel and ruthless. Why have you become so strange?"
"You are not the Ye Zhi I know. The Ye Zhi I know, admire, and admire will never be so cruel or unreasonable."
The sound is loud and powerful.
"This is a woman who has a relationship with you."
"My lord's former childhood sweetheart?"
Mrs. Bones and others couldn't help but feel the fire of gossip rising in their hearts, and they didn't dare to stop Shen Wei from walking toward Ye Hui.
"You are?"
Ye Tao looked at the familiar Shen Wei, but forgot his name.
unimportant.
He waved to Shen Wei and looked at the girl in front of him, with a fearless look in his eyes and the arrogance unique to a noble girl from a noble family.
"Are you trying to reason with me?"
"Can't we be reasonable? Everything in the world cannot function without Tao..."
Ye Tao slowly pulled out the blood-stained wooden stick from his waist: "Don't be afraid, I don't hit women. I care about women the most. You continue to talk."
The speed of drawing the sword is non-stop.
